about: Reusable management mechanics. 'engine' names the Game Definition Language (GDL) construct that implements it, so designers (human or local model) can compose mechanics without writing engine code. See docs/GDL.md.

mechanics.decision: Which candidate, at what salary, for which role; better people cost more and may refuse.
mechanics.feedback: Role performance drivers; staff quality affects delegated outcomes.
pitfalls: Hiring with no visible effect → feature bloat

mechanics.decision: Cut underperformers at the cost of severance, morale and reputation.
Invest training/time in people whose growth is uncertain.
Length vs flexibility vs cost; expiring deals create pressure points.
mechanics.feedback: Expiry calendar, needs-you item, cap/payroll view.

mechanics.decision: Offer terms against a counterparty's hidden reservation value; risk losing the deal vs overpaying.
mechanics.feedback: Accept / counter / reject with stated reasons.
pitfalls: Always accept at ask → fake negotiation
mechanics.engine: negotiations[] (terms, value, reservation, patience, reasons, memory)

mechanics.decision: Allocate scarce money across departments/initiatives with different payoffs and lags.
mechanics.feedback: Budget vs effect chart; Why? drivers.

mechanics.decision: Borrow to grow faster at the risk of distress in downturns.
mechanics.feedback: Debt schedule, interest line, rating, covenant warnings.

mechanics.decision: Raise money by giving up ownership/control.
Buy a rival or asset: price, financing, integration risk.
mechanics.feedback: Deal stages, integration progress, post-deal performance vs anti-portfolio.

mechanics.decision: Sell assets to raise cash or refocus.
Where and when to add a unit (route, location, show, market).
mechanics.feedback: Forecast with confidence band; ramp-up period; unit P&L.

mechanics.decision: Buy/lease capacity (aircraft, theaters, kitchens, rides) with long lead times.
Price for volume vs margin vs brand.
mechanics.feedback: Utilization and yield; demand curve preview.
pitfalls: Per-unit pricing chores → use pricing policy
mechanics.engine: unit field price + market logit + policy(auto-pricing)

mechanics.decision: Which customer segments to serve and how.
Spend to build awareness/brand with diminishing returns and decay.
mechanics.feedback: Awareness and buzz meters with drivers.

mechanics.decision: Long-term asset built by quality and integrity, spent by risky/cheap moves.
Treat counterparties well now for future leverage.
mechanics.engine: op: remember + memory() function in formulas

mechanics.decision: Balance pay, workload and culture to retain people.
mechanics.engine: stakeholders[] or person fields with drivers

mechanics.decision: Negotiate with organized labor; risk strikes vs cost increases.
mechanics.feedback: Union mood meter, contract expiry, strike events.

mechanics.decision: Spend to reduce uncertainty about talent/targets/markets.
mechanics.engine: fields with hidden:true + observe op + estimate display

mechanics.decision: Advance, accelerate, pause or kill projects at gates.
mechanics.feedback: Pipeline board, gate reviews, reveal moment.

mechanics.decision: Respond to or preempt rival moves.
mechanics.engine: orgs.archetypes + ai weights over shared actions

mechanics.decision: Comply, lobby, or risk penalties; scrutiny rises with market power.
mechanics.feedback: Regulator stance meter; investigations as events.

mechanics.decision: Respond to shocks under pressure with non-dominated options.
Time investments to the cycle; build reserves in good times.
mechanics.feedback: Economy panel with phase and outlook.

mechanics.decision: Hedge or ride volatile input prices (fuel, food, materials).
mechanics.feedback: Price chart; cost line in P&L.
mechanics.engine: world.vars process meanRevert + shocks; hedge action

mechanics.decision: Chase what's hot or bet on what's next.
Campaign for awards (cost) for prestige/demand boosts.
Meet objectives or lose autonomy/job.
mechanics.feedback: Objectives panel, confidence meter, ultimatum events.

mechanics.decision: Choose what to handle personally vs delegate, and to whom.
Grow to unlock bigger plays; each tier adds new problems.
mechanics.feedback: Tier banner, unlocked actions, milestone moments.

mechanics.decision: None directly—creates regret/learning stories.
mechanics.feedback: History entry: 'You passed on X; it became Y'.

mechanics.decision: Chase records and legacy.
mechanics.feedback: Record book, hall of fame, annual review.

mechanics.decision: Which nodes to connect; hubs create network effects.
pitfalls: Per-link micromanagement → use network strategy actions
mechanics.engine: kinds with link refs (a,b) + map section + market keyed by link

mechanics.decision: Partner for reach at the cost of independence/revenue share.
mechanics.engine: org relationship fields + negotiation + market formula bonus

mechanics.decision: Invest in product quality vs margin.
mechanics.engine: unit field with drivers feeding demand utility

mechanics.decision: Maintain vs replace aging assets.
When near bankruptcy: sell assets, raise rescue capital, restructure.
Player's own career: get hired, promoted, poached, fired.
None—context and story.
mechanics.engine: op: news + automatic news from history

mechanics.decision: Reshape the world for fun or testing.
